title: PayloadReadyPayload
description: Payload of the PayloadReady event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required. Dedupe key: docUuid+version (FR-M.12) — submission-svc's idempotent consumption of this at-least-once, idempotent-consumption-mandatory event keys on this pair, not on the envelope id alone. Bytes added 25 Sep 2026 (AD-30): submission-svc holds them with the queue item (FR-J.4); evidence-svc seals them as transmitted on SubmissionDespatched. Additive (INV-T-6234): optional regenerationKey (INV-Q-6228, INV-REQ-591: canonicalVersion, specificationVersion, packVersions, the key the payload regenerates under) and optional exchangeRate (INV-Q-6230, INV-REQ-512: the rate record used, with its provenance). Producer-enforced rules (not expressible in this schema; enforced by payload-svc): (a) no two packVersions items share a packRef; (b) exchangeRate is present exactly when the document currency is not SGD; (c) provenance.importId is present when provenance.kind is IMPORT and provenance.evidenceRef when it is MANUAL.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

payloadBytes.description: The built payload bytes, base64-encoded (opaque to this schema). A payload over 10 MB raises PAY-010 and yields PayloadRejected instead of PayloadReady (FR-4.13); inbound documents are at most 1 MB (VP-78), so payloads are normally far smaller.

amendmentClass.description: The amendment class this version represents relative to its predecessor (model/architecture/amendment-taxonomy.yaml); present when this version amends a prior one, absent on a document's first version.

regenerationKey.description: The regeneration key of this payload (INV-REQ-591): canonical version, specification version and pack versions. Optional; absent on a payload built before the key was recorded.

exchangeRate.description: The exchange-rate record used for this document (INV-REQ-512, INV-AC-530), with its source and load provenance. Present exactly when the document currency is not SGD (producer-enforced).

RegenerationKey.description: Key of the regeneration invariant (INV-REQ-591). No two packVersions items share a packRef (producer-enforced).

specificationVersion.description: The specification version recorded on the submission version.

packVersions.description: The pack versions used; packRef values are unique (producer-enforced).

rate.description: Decimal string, the masterdata ExchangeRate.rate form.

RateProvenance.description: Load provenance of the rate record. importId is present when kind is IMPORT and evidenceRef when kind is MANUAL (producer-enforced).
